corrections.reason: The glyph is 'ደ' forming 'ቢደርስ' ('when the time arrived'), which was misread as 'ቢያርስ'.
In the Ge'ez root quote (John 4:5), the printed character is 1st-order 'አ' ('አዐደ ወይን'), without a 3rd-order ring.
The Amharic gloss for 'አዐደ ወይን' is 'ለወይኑ ቦታ' ('near the vineyard plot'); faded strokes on 'ለወይኑ' were misread as 'አውደኑ'.
The printed word is 'አሣነሳት' ('he diminished/humbled her from honor', translating Genesis 34:2 'አሕሰራ'), with 'ሣ' misread as 'ማ'.
Continuing from 'ግ-' at the end of line 12, the word is 'ግብርት' ('noble/free woman'), where 'ብ' was misread as 'ገ'.
The printed glyph is 4th-order 'ያ' forming 'ያገሩም ሰዎች' ('the people of the country'), misread as 1st-order 'የ'.
A small typesetter's spacer smudge between 'ቁ' and 'ስል' in 'ቁስል' ('wound/soreness') was misread as an extra character 'ሩ'.
